location.climate: Four seasons, cold winters (-5°C to 3°C), warm humid summers (22-30°C)

application_requirements.application_platform: Common App or Coalition App or QuestBridge

required_documents.notes: Two teacher recommendations from academic subjects
Yale-specific short essays plus Common App essay
Alumni interview if available - highly encouraged

english_proficiency.waiver_conditions: Primary language is English or 4 years in English-medium school

academic_programs.curriculum_structure: Distributional requirements + Skills requirements + Major + Electives

korean_student_specific.korean_food_access: Limited in New Haven - some Korean restaurants downtown (15 min walk), better access in NYC (1.5 hours)
korean_student_specific.korean_church_proximity: Korean Church of New Haven (15 min), better options in NYC area

historical_admit_patterns.common_profiles: Strong writers, debate/Model UN stars, community leaders, humanities-oriented students with genuine intellectual curiosity

korean_specific_advice: Yale especially values strong writers - essays are crucial
Show genuine engagement with ideas, not just achievements
Political engagement and global awareness valued highly
The 'Why Yale' essay should show specific knowledge of residential college culture
Arts and humanities strengths appreciated more than at some peers
Interview is important - prepare thoughtful questions about Yale
Demonstrate how you'll engage with Yale's collaborative, discussion-based culture
common_korean_applicant_mistakes: Essays too achievement-focused without showing intellectual depth
Not demonstrating awareness of Yale's unique residential college system
Overemphasis on STEM without showing humanities appreciation
Generic 'Why Yale' essay that could apply to any school
Not showing authentic voice in writing
Interview too formal - Yale values genuine conversation

campus_life.dining_options: Residential college dining halls, Commons, campus cafes
campus_life.safety_rating: Good - Yale Police, shuttle services, emergency phones
campus_life.nearby_attractions: New York City (1.5 hours), Long Island Sound beaches, Yale museums

career_outcomes.korean_alumni_network: Active Yale Korean Alumni Association with strong law/policy connections
